title: DISCOVER
summary: Explore interactive satellite maps, 4K high-altitude video reels, and topographic dossiers.
details: Immerse yourself in our Karakoram, Himalayan, and Hindu Kush topographic archives. Inspect 8,000m giants like K2, Nanga Parbat, and Broad Peak, or serene high-alpine glacial valleys like Hunza, Skardu, and Deosai.
protocols: Topographical satellite route reconnaissance
High-altitude photography & documentary footage inspection
Target peak altitude profiling and difficulty grading

title: CHOOSE
summary: Select your mountain domain, seasonal weather window, elevation target, and route profile.
details: Choose between high glacial siege domains (Baltoro/Concordia), peaceful apricot orchard valleys (Hunza/Nagar), or alpine meadows beneath 8,126m Killer Mountain (Fairy Meadows). Compare routes side-by-side.
protocols: Seasonal Karakoram weather window validation (Summer vs Autumn)
Acclimatization curve vs time constraints matching
Trailhead access point selection (Askole, Raikot, or Karimabad)

title: CUSTOMIZE
summary: Tailor shelter, cuisine plans, 4x4 mountain vehicles, satellite comms, and UIAGM guide ratios.
details: Use our 9-step Expedition Builder to customize every dimension of your journey. Receive an immediate transparent investment estimate with applied group and early planning privileges.
protocols: Shelter tier selection (Wilderness tents to royal fort palaces)
High-metabolism nutrition and dietary preference assignment
Dedicated UIAGM lead guide and personal porter allocation

title: PREPARE
summary: Complete physical conditioning, high-altitude gear fitting, and official mountaineering clearance.
details: Receive your personalized official expedition dossier. Our medical advisors guide your Diamox acclimatization schedule, high-altitude gear checklist, and emergency evacuation insurance clearance.
protocols: Zone-2 aerobic conditioning & high-altitude breathing regimens
B3 mountaineering double-boot fitting and crampon verification
Ministry of Tourism mountaineering permit processing & insurance

title: TRAVEL
summary: Arrive at Islamabad, transit scenic Karakoram gorges or board domestic mountain flights past Nanga Parbat.
details: Meet your dedicated Alpine Ascents expedition liaison at Islamabad International Airport. Transfer via domestic mountain flight past Nanga Parbat or travel the engineering marvel of the Karakoram Highway.
protocols: Airport reception and expedition duffel weighing (25kg porter limit)
Government liaison officer briefing & satellite transponder activation
Scenic flight or 4x4 convoy through Indus and Hunza river gorges

title: EXPLORE
summary: Trek along ancient moraines, cross suspension bridges, and sleep beneath pristine dark skies.
details: Step onto lateral glacier moraines. Traverse jaw-dropping gorges, view colossal granite spires like Trango Towers, and establish high camps with structured active rest rotations and daily vital checks.
protocols: Paced daily trekking stages with 500m daily elevation ascent cap
Twice-daily pulse oximetry and acute mountain sickness logs
Evening hot culinary feasts prepared by mountain camp chefs

title: ADVENTURE
summary: Reach Concordia, touch K2 Base Camp, cross technical passes, or stand atop legendary alpine crests.
details: Achieve your apex goal — standing in Concordia surrounded by four 8,000-meter giants, touching K2 Base Camp, or summiting an alpine peak with your UIAGM rope team.
protocols: Alpine dawn alpine start under headlamp with certified rope teams
Technical ice and crampon navigation over glacial seracs
Apex summit celebration and high-resolution photographic archival

title: RETURN
summary: Descend to valley comforts, celebrate with your local Balti team, and receive your verified summit dossier.
details: Leave No Trace environmental clean-up. Descend to royal heritage palace suites, enjoy hot mineral springs in Shigar or Hunza, and celebrate with your faithful high-altitude porters before returning home.
protocols: Porter appreciation ceremony, transparent gratuity distribution
Official summit certificate and Alpine Passport digital badge logging
Restorative hot spring baths and international flight connections
